heroHeadline: Day 957: Board of Peace Formally Presents Six-Month Gaza Ceasefire Progress Report to UNSC — Hamas Named 'Principal Obstacle' to Phase Two; IDF Documents 19 Hamas Ceasefire Violations May 6–20, Hamas Rearming During Truce — 40 Days to Israel July 1 Supreme Court Accountability Deadline
heroSubtitle: The deadliest attack on Jewish people since the Holocaust — assault timeline, hostage crisis resolved January 2026, intelligence failures, and IDF response. May 21, 2026 (Day 957): The Board of Peace chaired by Nickolay Mladenov formally presented its six-month Gaza ceasefire progress report to the UN Security Council, calling Hamas demilitarization 'non-negotiable' and identifying Hamas as the 'principal obstacle' to Phase Two — the most direct multilateral escalation of pressure on the Gaza deadlock yet. Hamas rejected the report as containing 'fallacies that absolve the occupying government.' Phase Two negotiations (Hamas disarmament, Israeli withdrawal) remain in total collapse: all four Board of Peace deadlines (Apr 11, 14, 19, late-April) expired without agreement. IDF operational plans for a resumed Gaza ground offensive are complete, pending US authorization. On May 20 (Day 956): The IDF published its bi-weekly ceasefire compliance report documenting 19 Hamas violations May 6–20 — including IED and anti-tank rocket production, weapons smuggling, and military training exercises — demonstrating Hamas's systematic military reconstitution during the truce. The Board of Peace six-month progress report, published May 20, named Hamas as the principal obstacle to Phase Two implementation. Accountability front: 40 days remain until the Supreme Court's July 1 deadline. The Kallner inquiry bill — which dropped 'independent investigation' language and bars judges — advances toward a late-May first plenum reading; the opposition Beyachad alliance (Bennett-Lapid) has pledged an independent state commission as Day 1 of any new government. JPPI poll (May 15): 63% of Israelis support an independent commission. Earlier: On May 18 (Day 954), Hamas appointed Mohammed Odeh — former military intelligence chief and October 7 intelligence planner — as the new Al-Qassam Brigades commander, succeeding the IDF-killed Izz al-Din al-Haddad. Gaza ceasefire: 2,400+ violations documented, 857+ Palestinians killed since Oct 10, 2025 ceasefire; Israel controls 60%+ of Gaza; less than $1B of $17B pledged reconstruction funds received.
